# telnyx_voice_clones (Data Source)

Lists voice clones, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_voice_clone`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_voice_clones" "active" {
  filter_provider = "telnyx"
}

output "voice_ids" {
  value = { for v in data.telnyx_voice_clones.active.voice_clones : v.name => v.provider_voice_id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_model_id` (String) One of `Bayan`, `Pro`, `Qwen3TTS`, `Turbo`, `Ultra`, `Urdu`, `speech-2.8-turbo`.
- `filter_name` (String)
- `filter_provider` (String) One of `Minimax`, `Resemble`, `Telnyx`, `minimax`, `resemble`, `telnyx`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `-name`, `created_at`, `name`.

### Read-Only

- `voice_clones` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--voice_clones))

<a id="nestedatt--voice_clones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `voice_clones`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the voice clone was created.
- `gender` (String) Gender of the voice clone.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the voice clone.
- `label` (String) Voice style description. If not explicitly set on upload, falls back to the source design's prompt text.
- `language` (String) Language code of the voice clone (ISO 639-1, or the Resemble catalogue code such as `en-US`).
- `model_id` (String) TTS model identifier for the voice clone.
- `name` (String) Name of the voice clone.
- `provider` (String) Voice synthesis provider used for this clone.
- `provider_supported_models` (List of String) List of TTS model identifiers supported by this clone's provider.
- `provider_voice_id` (String) Provider-specific voice identifier used for TTS synthesis. May differ from the clone UUID depending on the provider and model.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the resource type.
- `source_voice_design_id` (String) UUID of the source voice design. `null` for upload-based clones.
- `source_voice_design_version` (Number) Version of the source voice design used. `null` for upload-based clones.
- `status` (String) Clone status. pending for Ultra clones while on-prem import is in progress, active once ready, failed if verification timed out, expired if not kept alive.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the voice clone was last updated.
